dg=[list(map(int,x)) for x in ds.split()]; expected=[list(map(int,x)) for x in do.split()]
print([len(row) for row in dg])
HH,WW=len(dg),len(dg[0]); ext=set();q=deque()
for r in range(HH):
 for c in range(WW):
  if (r in (0,HH-1) or c in (0,WW-1)) and dg[r][c]==0:ext.add((r,c));q.append((r,c))
while q:
 r,c=q.popleft()
 for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
  a,b=r+dr,c+dc
  if 0<=a<HH and 0<=b<WW and dg[a][b]==0 and (a,b) not in ext:ext.add((a,b));q.append((a,b))

cid={}; i=0

 for c in range(WW):

   q=[(r,c)];cid[(r,c)]=i

     for dc in [-1,0,1]:
      a,b=x+dr,y+dc
      if 0<=a<HH and 0<=b<WW and dg[a][b] and (a,b) not in cid:cid[(a,b)]=i;q.append((a,b))
   i+=1
sel={cid[(r+dr,c+dc)] for r,c in insideD for dr in [-1,0,1] for dc in [-1,0,1] if (r+dr,c+dc) in cid}
outD=[row[:] for row in dg]
for r in range(HH):
 for c in range(WW):

  adj={cid[(r+dr,c+dc)] for dr in [-1,0,1] for dc in [-1,0,1] if (dr,dc)!=(0,0) and (r+dr,c+dc) in cid}
  if adj&sel:outD[r][c]=3 if (r,c) in insideD else 2
print('comps',i,'inside',len(insideD),'selected',sel,'diff',[(r,c,outD[r][c],expected[r][c]) for r in range(HH) for c in range(WW) if outD[r][c]!=expected[r][c]])
